anāgatārthakriyāsamartho hi pravṛttiviṣayo na ca tatsāmarthyaṃ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ niścīyata ityuktaṃ
paricchinnaśca pravṛttiviṣaya iṣyate na ca santānaḥ pratyakṣādikṣaṇena paricchinnastatkathaṃ pravṛttiviṣayaḥ
athaikasmin kṣaṇe pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttamapi niścayavaśāt kṣaṇasāmānyaviṣayatvenaikasantativiṣayantadayuktaṃ

yasmādanyatrābhimate hetau pratyakṣabādhāyā abhāvaniyamābhāvāt
na hi sambandhābhyupagame parasya bādhāśaṅkā nivarttata iti bhāvaḥ
tasmāt pratibandhānabhyupagamavādinā vṛttaṃ pramāṇaṃ bādhakameṣṭavyaṃ
avṛttabādhane'pravṛttenaiva pramāṇena bādhane sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ sarvatra hetau na syādāśvāso gamakatvaniścayaḥ
bādhakasya śaṃkyamānatvāt
naivaṃ pratibandhavādinaḥ sarvatra hetāvanāśvāsaḥ sādhyapratibaddhe hetau bādhāśaṃkāyā apyabhāvāt
hetuprayogāttu pūrvaṃ syād bādhāśaṃkā
ata eva sandigdhe hetuvacanamucyate

tathā hi nirātmakeṣvātmarahiteṣu ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣu prāṇādyadarśanāt prāṇāpānonmeṣanimeṣādarśanāt

adṛṣṭeṣvapi tajjātīyatayā

adṛśyasyātmanonupalambhād ghaṭādisvabhāvāprasiddhau ghaṭādīnānnairātmyāsiddheḥ kāraṇānnirātmakāt prāṇāderanivṛttiḥ

anyādṛśādapyavahnisadṛśādapi yadi tādṛśo bhaved vahnijanitadhūmatulyasvabhāvo bhavet

kiṅkāraṇaṃ
niḥśeṣidarśanādarśanāyattatvād darśanamātrapratibaddhāyā anvayavyatirekapratipatteḥ
evaṃ hi darśanamanvayaṃ sādhayati yadi niḥśeṣe sapakṣe hetordarśanaṃ syāt
evamadarśanamapi vyatirekaṃ sādhayet
yadi niḥśeṣe sādhyavyatireke hetoradarśanaṃ syāt
yathaikatra dhūmavyaktau sakṛdapi kāryatvasiddhyā sarvatra tathābhāvaḥ
evaṃ kvacit sapakṣāsapakṣayordarśanādarśanāt sarvatrānvayavyatirekaniścayo bhaviṣyatītyapi mithyā
yasmāt kvacid amūrtatve ākāśādigate nityatvasya darśane
paraprasiddhyā caitaducyate
anyatra sukhādau
anyathetyanityatve hetoramūrttatvasya dṛṣṭeḥ kāraṇādekatra darśanaṃ na sarvatra tathābhāvasādhanamato darśanamanvaye vyabhicāri
tathā kvacid ghaṭādau nityatvābhāvepyadṛṣṭasyāmūrttatvasya punarnityatvābhāva eva sukhādau dṛṣṭerato vipakṣaikadeśādarśanamasādhanaṃ vyatirekaniścaye tasmāddhetuphalabhāvaniścayādevānvayavyatirekayorniścayaḥ
svabhāva ityādi paraḥ
idānīmiti kāryahetāvavinābhāve sādhite saṃprati svabhāvahetau kartha sādhyenāvinābhāvaḥ
nanu svabhāve bhāvopi bhāvamātrānurodhini heturityādinā prāgeva svabhāva- hetāvavinābhāvaḥ sādhitaḥ
satyaṃ
evantu manyate
yathābhūte svabhāve tanmātrabhāvinyavinābhāvo varṇṇitastatra pratijñārthaikadeśatā prāpnotīti
siddhāntavādyapyanantareṇānyāpohaprasādhanena pratijñārthaikadeśatāparihārammanyamānaḥ tanmātrānurodhinyevāvinābhāvaṃ pūrvoktamanuvadati
svabhāvepyavinābhāva ityādi
svabhāvepi svabhāvahetāvapyavinābhāvaḥ
kasmin sādhye
bhāvamātrānurodhini
yo hītyādyasyaiva vyākhyānaṃ
avinābhāvo bhāvasyeti kṛtakatvādeḥ
yasmāt tadabhāve bhāvamātrānurodhisādhyadharmābhāve bhāvasya hetutvenopāttasyābhāvaḥ syātḥ

ya evānityādiko bhāvaḥ kṛtakabhāvamātrānurodhī-svabhāva ityucyate sa eva svayamanyanimittānapekṣatayā vastutaḥ paramārthato bhāvaḥ kṛtakatvaṃ sa ca bhāva ātmānaṃ svabhāvabhūtamanityatvamparityajya kathambhavet
ya eva tarhīti paraḥ
pakṣanirdeśaḥ pratijñā
tasyā artho dharmadharmisamudāyastasyaikadeśaḥ sādhyadharmātmako hetuḥ syāt
tathā hi yāvaduktamanityaḥ śabdo'nityatvāditi tāvad anityaḥ kṛtakatvāditi tathā cāsiddho heturiti bhāvaḥ
Nyāyasūtra.
1: 1: 33.
naiṣa doṣa iti si ddhā nta vā dī
yasmāt sarve bhāvā ityādi
atra prathamayā kārikayā dharmakalpanābījaṃ
dvitīyayā dharmakalpanā
tṛtīyayā pratijñārthaikadeśatāparihāraśca kathyate iti samudāyārthaḥ
sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvaparabhāvābhyāṃ vyāvṛttimbhajanta iti ghinuṇ
sarvabhāvāḥ svabhāvena svarūpeṇa na pararūpeṇa sajātīyād vijātīyācca vyāvṛttāḥ
svasvabhāvavyavasthiteḥ
svasmin svabhāve'vasthānāt
nanvaśvādibhyo gaurjātyā bhinnaḥ
viṣāṇī gaurdravyeṇa govyaktyantarād bhinnaḥ
śuklo gaurguṇena viṣāṇino govyaktyantarād bhinna iti
evamādiparamāṇvanto bhedo jātyādiviśeṣaṇakṛtaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ na svabhāveneti
atrocyate
na jātyādinā tāvad bhāvānāmabhinnānāmbhedaḥ kriyate
bhinnābhinnabhedakaraṇe tatra tasyākiñcitkaratvāt
nāpi bhinnānāmvaiyarthyāt
nāpyeṣāmbhedavyavahāraḥ kriyate svarūpabhinnānāmpratyakṣe'vabhāsādeva bhedavyavahārasiddheḥ
kiñca
jātyādīnāmanyonyantadvataśca sakāśād bhedo nānyato jātyāde ranavasthāprasaṅgāt
svarūpeṇa ca bhede bhāvānāmevāsau kinnābhyupagamyate kiṃ jātyādikalpanayā
yopi di ga mba ro manyate
sarvātmakamekaṃ syādanyāpohavyatikrame
tasmād bheda evānyathā na syād anyonyābhāvo bhāvānāṃ yadi na bhavediti
sopyanena nirastaḥ
abhāvena bhāvabhedasya karttumaśakyatvāt
nāpyabhinnānāṃ hetuto niṣpannānāmanyonyābhāvaḥ sambhavati
bhinnāścet niṣpannāḥ kathamanyonyābhāvaḥ sambhavati
bhinnāścen niṣpannāḥ kathamanyonyābhāvakalpanetyuktaṃ
nanu sarve bhāvā bhinnā iti yadyetadanumānavṛttantadāśrayāsiddho hetuḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ pratyakṣāviṣayatvād
ata eva naitat pratyakṣavṛttaṃ parāmṛśyate
anyastvāha
yadyapi bhāvāḥ svabhāvena bhinnāsteṣāntu jātyādayo dharmāssantyeva pratīyamānatvāt
tathāpi nirvikalpakantu vijñānaṅgavādiṣu sattāmātraṃ gṛhvāti na bhedaṃ
anyasmād viśeṣagrahaṇameva hi bhedagrahaṇamviśeṣaśca nāvikalpya gṛhyata iti savikalpakasya viṣayo na nirvikalpasya
taduktaṃ
viśeṣāstu pratīyante savikalpakabuddhibhiḥ
te ca kecit pratidravyaṃ kecid vahuṣu saṃsthitāḥ
tānakalpayadutpannaṃ vyāvṛttānugamātmanā
gavāśve copajātantu pratyakṣanna viśiṣyata iti
tasmānna nirvikalpake pratyakṣabhedāvabhāsa iti
yopyāha
savikalpakenāpi bhedo na gṛhyate'nyonyābhāvagrahaṇanimittako hi bhāvānāṃ bhedagrahonyonyābhāvaśca bhedo na cābhāvaḥ
pratyakṣagrāhyo
na hi gavyaśvostīti pratyakṣaṃ paricchinattyataḥ sattāmātrasyaiva grāhakaṃ pratyakṣamiti
taduktaṃ ma ṇḍa ne na
āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣaṃ na niṣeddhya vipaścitaḥ
naikatva āgamastena pratyakṣeṇa virudhyata iti
tadetadubhayamapyayuktaṃ
sattāmātrasyāpratibhāsanāt
gavāśvādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇaiva pratibhāsanāt
taduktaṃ
tattvayuktampratidravyaṃ bhinnarūpopalambhanāt
na hyākhyātumaśakyatvād bhedo nāstīti gamyata iti
yopyāha
bhāvānāmbheda eva nāsti
tathā hi goraśvānutpāde yādṛśaṃ svarūpamaśvotpādepi tādṛśameva nāparamadhikaṃ kiñcijjātamiti kathamato bhedaḥ
bhavatu vā bhedo nāsau pratyakṣagrāhyo'smādayambhinna iti
evaṃrūpasya vyāpārasya pratyakṣe'bhāvāt
yadāha
na hīdamiyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samarthamiti
sopi nirastaḥ
gavāśvādīnāṃ svasvarūpeṇotpattireva bhedaḥ
te ca svasvarūpeṇa pratyakṣevabhāsante
tathāvabhāsaśca loke bhedāvabhāsa iti yatkiñcidetat
tasmāt purovasthiteṣu svasvabhāvavyavasthiterityasya hetoḥ
pratyakṣeṇa bhedaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa pratipadyate'taḥ sarvabhāvā vyāvṛttibhāgina iti vyāptigrahaṇapramāṇaphalamiti
yataśca jātyādayorthāntarabhūtā na santīti pratipādayiṣyate
ataḥ pāramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvo nāstītyuktambhavati
nanu sāmānyayogāt sajātīyā ucyante
yadi ca sāmānyannāsti kathaṃ sajātīyād vyāvṛttirityucyate
naitadasti
na samānānāmutpannānāmbhāvānāṃ sāmānyayogāt samānarūpatā svahetubhya eva tathāniṣpannatvāt
tena yadu dyo ta ka re ṇo cyate
na gavi gotvaṃ yena gotvayogāt prāg gaurevāsāviti vyarthaṃ gotvaṃ syād
api tu yadaiva vastu tadaiva gotvenābhisambadhyate
gotvayogāttu prāg vastu na vidyate
na cāvidyamānaṅ gauriti vā'gauriti vā śakyaṃ vyapadeṣṭumiti
tannirastaṃ
yadaiva vastu tadaiva tasya gorūpatayā niṣpannatvāt kiṃ gotvayogena
nāpyasamānānāṃ sāmānyayogāt samānarūpatā
teṣāṃ sāmānyasyaivābhāvāt
samānānāṃ ca bhāvaḥ sāmānyamityabhyupagamyate
sāmānyācca samānarūpatve bhāvānāmabhyupagamyamāne yāvanna sāmānyayogastāvanna samānā bhāvāḥ
yāvacca na samānāstāvanna sāmānyayoga ityanyonyāśrayatvaṃ syāt
tasmāt svahetubhya eva samānā utpannāḥ
tena
śāvaleyācca bhinnatvaṃ bāhuleyāśvayossamaṃ
sāmānyaṃ nānyadiṣṭaṃ cet kvāgopohaḥ prakalpyatāmiti
nirastaṃ
sāmānyeṣvevāgopohaprakalpanāt
asamānānāṃ cāpohyātmatayā prakalpanāt
yadapyuccate
samānā iti pratibhāsādeva nirvikalpake jñāne sāmānyapratibhāsonyathā bāhuleyāśvavat
śāvaleyabāhuleyayorapi vailakṣaṇyapratītiḥ syāt sarvātmanā bhedād
bhavati ca samānā iti pratītistasmādasyaiva sāmānyamiti
taduktaṃ
nirvikalpakabodhena dvyātmakasya vastuno grahaṇamiti
yadvā savikalpake na cet sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate
nirvikalpakenāpi gṛhītameva
savikalpā bhinnapratibhāsatvāt
tathā hi
ya eva śāvaleyādayo gauriti jñānena gṛhyante
ta eva nirvikalpake jñāne pratibhāsante kevalamekantānavikalpya gṛhṇātyanyad vikalpyeti tayoḥ svarūpabhedo na pratibhāsabhedaḥ
tasmānnirvikalpakepi jñāne sāmānyaṃ pratibhāsata iti
tadapi nirastaṃ
svahetubhya eva keṣāñcit samānānāṃ pratibhāsanāt
sāmānyasya ca vyaktiparatantraṃ svarūpaṃ na ca nirvikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ pāratantryamvastuno gṛhṇāti
svātantryeṇa vastugrāhitvāt tatkathaṃ sāmānyagrāhakamucyate
anugatasya ca rūpasya pratyekavad yugapad bahuṣvapratibhāsanāt
ata eva vikalpaḥ samāneṣvekāntabhinneṣu nirvikalpakapratyakṣabādhitamanugatākāraṃ gṛhṇan bhrānto bhavati
nirvikalpakagṛhītasāmānyagrāhī vā'pramāṇaṃ syād gṛhītagrāhitvāt
atha vikalpya grāhitvād agṛhītagrāhitvaṃ smṛtyāderapitarhi smaryamāṇaviṣayatā gṛhītagrāhitvanna syāt
atha jātyādiviśiṣṭavastugrāhitayā vikalpasyāgṛhītagrāhitvamevamapi yadi jātyādiviśiṣṭatvamvastunaḥ pāramārthiko dharmastadā nirvikalpakenāpi gṛhītameveti kathamagṛhītagrāhitvam
atha kalpikastadā tadgrāhakasya kathaṃ prāmāṇyamāropitārthatvāt
tasmānnāstyeva jātyādiriti sthitaṃ
kathantarhi bhāvā vyāvṛttibhāgina ityucyante
kalpitadharmadvāreṇāyaṃ vyapadeśa ityadoṣaḥ
ataḥ
agonivṛttiḥ sāmānyaṃ vācyaṃ yaiḥ parikalpyate
gotvavastveva tairuktamagopohagirā sphuṭamiti
Ślokavārtika.
Apohavāda.
nirastaṃ
pāramārthikasya gotvasya niṣedhaḥ kriyate na tu kalpitasyeti vakṣyati
yadi paramārthiko dharmadharmibhāvo nāsti kathantarhi kṛtakaḥ śabdo nitya iti buddhīnāmbhedaḥ śabdaikasvarūpaviṣayatvāt
atha nirviṣayā etā vāsanābījamātrataḥ
pratipattiḥ pravṛttiśca bāhyertheṣu kathambhavet
atha bāhyādhyavasāyāt pravṛttirevamapi kṛtakatvasya yovasāyaḥ sa evānityasyābhedāditi kathambuddhibhedaḥ
kṛtakānityayorabhedādeva tadanubhavāhitavāsanābhedasyābhāvānna tattvato buddhibheda ityatrāha
yasmādityādi
yasmāt sarvasmāt sarvabhāvā vyāvṛttāstasmād yato yato nityākṛtakādeḥ śabdādīnāmarthānāṃ vyāvṛttistannibandhanāḥ
vyāvṛttyāvadhivyā vṛttinibandhanā dharmabhedā anityakṛtakādayaḥ kalpyante vikalpairāropyante
kimviśiṣṭāstadviśeṣāvagāhinaḥ
tasya svalakṣaṇasya ye viśeṣā akṛtakādivyāvṛttirūpalakṣaṇāstadavagāhinaḥ
tadavagāhanaśīlāstadabhedāvabhāsanaśīlā ityarthaḥ
etaduktambhavati
akṛtako na bhavatītyanena dvāreṇa prabodhitāyā eva kṛtakavikalpavāsanāyā eṣā prakṛtiryatastato vikalpa utpadyamānaḥ kṛtaka iti svākārābhinnaḥ sa kṛtakavyāvṛttameva śabdasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyate na tvanitya iti
tathā nityo na bhavatītyanenāpi dvāreṇa prabodhitāyā evānityavāsanāyāḥ sāmarthyaṃ yattato vikalpa utpadyamāno'nitya iti svākārābhinnaṃ nityavyāvṛttameva śabdasvalakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyate na tu kṛtaka iti
tena buddhibhedo bhavati
yataśca bādhyamānatvād vikalpapratibhāsyartho bāhyo na bhavatyato vāsanāvaśādeva bāhyāvabhāso vikalpastena vikalpasya bāhyarūpa eva pratibhāsamānorthaḥ svākāra ucyate
na tu svākāre bāhyāropaḥ sādṛśyāt
yadāha
nāmanimittaprakaraṇe
Pramāṇavārtika 3: 12.
sārūpyād bhrāntito vṛttirarthe cet syānna sarvadā
deśabhrāntiśca na jñāne tulyamutpattito dhiyaḥ
tathāvidhāyā bāhyārthapratibhāsāyā iti
etena yaducyate
yadvāhyātyantavisadṛśasya svākārasya tādrūpyagrahaṇantadanyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyaparaṃ
yathā ghaṭavisadṛśopi paṭo vṛkṣābhāvaviśiṣṭo'vadhāryamāṇo yamapyavṛkṣa iti ghaṭasadṛśovadhāryate
vṛkṣavyāvṛtterghaṭapaṭayostulyatvāt
tathā vikalpaviṣayo'tyantaṃ vāme visadṛśopi vāme'vadhāryate'nyanivṛttikṛtasārūpya grahaṇāditi
tadapāstaṃ
svahetuta eva bāhyābhāsāyā vikalpabuddherutpatteḥ
na cāsadṛśānāmanyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate
tatra tasyā bhedābhedasādṛśyakaraṇe'kiñcitkaratvāt
na cānyanivṛttiḥ sadṛśī vidyate
sadṛśānāmapi kathamanyanivṛttyā sādṛśyaṃ kriyate svarūpeṇaiva sādṛśyāt
nāpi pūrvaṃ svākārapratibhāsaḥ paścāt tatrānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyagrahaṇaparo bāhyāropaḥ pratibhāsate
na hi marīcikāyāṃ pūrvaṃ svarūpāpratibhāse sati sādṛśyagrahaṇahetuko jalāropaḥ sambhavati
bāhyāropācca pūrvaṃ na svākāro grāhyāroposti
vikalpasyaivābhāvāt
bhāve bodhaikarūpa evāsāviti na bāhyasadṛśaḥ
tataścānyanivṛttikṛtasādṛśyābhāvāt kathambāhyarūpaḥ pratīyate
anumānasya tu nānyanivṛttigrahaṇapūrvikā pravṛttirliṅgasya tayā saha sambandhāt siddheḥ
yadā ca tadviśeṣāvagāhitvamvikalpānāṃ pratīyate tadā vidhirūpeṇaiva pravṛttirvastusvarūpasya vidhoyamānatvenādhyavasāyādarthādanyanivṛttiḥ pratīyate
tena vidhireva śabdārthosmākamapi
bāhyatayā'ropitasya ca vidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ sambandhaḥ
nanu niyatarūpagrāhī vikalpaḥ pratibhāsate
tenetararūpaśūnyameva vikalpayanniyatamarthaṃ vikalpayati
tasmādyanniyatarūpāvadhāraṇantadanyanivṛttiviṣayantatkathamucyate vidhireva śabdārtha iti
tadayuktaṃ
anyanivṛttimahaṃ vikalpayāmītyapratīteḥ
na ca sa vikalpaviṣayo yo na vikalpya pratibhāsate
yadi cetararūpanivṛttimeva vikalpayanniyatamarthamvikalpayati tadetaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ syāt
itararūpasyāpi niyatarūpatvenānyanivṛttidvāreṇa pratipattiprasaṅgāt
atha vidhirūpeṇetararūpaṃ vikalpayati na tarhi tadanyanivṛttyavadhāraṇapūrvakanniyatarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ
na ca yathā sāmānyavantamarthampaśyāmīti nāsti jātitadvatorviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve pratibhāsaḥ
atha ca viśiṣṭapratyayānurodhāt sāmānyaviśiṣṭavyaktidarśanannaiyā yi kā dayaḥ kalpitavantastathā'nye nivṛttimahamvikalpayāmītyapratītāvapi bāhyasadṛśāropānyathānupapattyānyanivṛttiparaṃ vikalpākāre bāhyarūpamāropyata iti yuktaṃ
sādṛśyamantareṇa vāsanābalādevādhyavasitabāhyarūpasya vikalpasyotpatteḥ
yadāha
tadanubhavāhitavāsanāprabhavaprakṛteradhyavasitatadbhāvasvarūpaṃ
tathā vikalpavāsanāyāśca tādṛśī prakṛtiryadevameṣā pratibhātīti
nāpi bāhyarūpāropakasya jñānasyānyavittikṛtasārūpyanimittatvepyanyanivṛttiviṣayatvaṃ
na hi marīcikāyāṃ jalajñānasya sādṛśyaviṣayatvamāropitajalaviṣayatvāt
na ca niyataṃ rūpaṃ bhāvānāmanyanivṛttyā kriyate
tasyā avastutvenākārakatvāt
svahetubhya eva ca tato tpatte
nāpi niyatarūpāvadhāraṇantadanyanivṛttiviṣayaṃ niyatarūpaviṣayatvādasya
ata eva na tadanyanivṛttipurassarameva dhāryate pratyakṣeṇaiva
na ca tadanyanivṛttirarthāntarabhūtā yujyata iti vakṣyati
nāpi sā tattvānyatvābhyāmavācyā yujyate
evaṃ hyabhāva evāsyāḥ syācchaśaviṣāṇavat
na ca syāt pratyakṣagamyā nīrūpatvāt
nāpyanumānagamyā
sambandhābhāvena liṅgasyāsiddheḥ
nāpi niyatarūpānyathānupapattyā tatkalpanā
aniyatarūpāṇāmanyanivṛtterabhāvāt
niyatarūpāṇāṃ ca kathamanyanivṛttyā niyatarūpatvaṃ svahetubhya eva niyatarūpāṇāmutpatteḥ
tasmānniyatarūpāvadhāraṇapurassaraivānyanivṛttiḥ pratīyate
tathā hi ghaṭa ityukte'ghaṭo na bhavatīti sāmarthyāt pratīyate'to vikalpakalpitaiveṣā na paramārthatosti
tasmāt sthitametacchadbaliṅgābhyāmvidhirūpeṇa vastu pratipādyaterthādanyaniṣeghaḥ

nanu tadityullekhenānutpatteḥ kathaṃ smṛtirūpaḥ

tato bādhyabādhakabhāvāt kāraṇāt samāropaviveke samāropavirahaniścayasyāsya pravṛttiriti gamyate

tadviveka evānyāpohaḥ samāropaviveka eva cānyāpohaḥ

yadi tu pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvinā niṣcayena vastusvabhāvasya niścayaḥ kriyate tadā tatsvabhāvaniścaye ca niraṃśatvād vastunastasyāyogādanyasyākārāntarasyāniścayāyogāt
yataśca vastvadhyavasāyenaiva niścayasya pravṛttiḥ śabdasya vā na vastusvarūpagrāhakatvena

atha nirviṣayā etā vāsanāmātrabhāvataḥ

nīlādayo dharmā anupādhiḥ
pāratantryābhāvāt
anyathā'syāyamupādhirityeva na syāt
atheṣyate dravyaviṣayaṃ pāratantryaṃ dharmāṇāntadā pāratantryepi dravyajanyatvamaṅgīkarttavyamanyathā dravyapāratantryāyogāt
janakaṃ ca kṣaṇikameṣṭavyamakṣaṇikasyārthakriyāyogāt
tataśca kāryābhimatānāmupādhīnāṃ kāraṇābhimatasya ca dravyasya sahānavasthiteḥ kāraṇāt
dvayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorvasturūpayoryugapadanabhidhānaṃ
kāraṇābhimatasya viśeṣasya tadānīṃ nirodhāt
ekasyeti viśiṣṭasyāpyupādhimataḥ
adhyāhāra upadarśanantadā na vastuviṣayaḥ śabdārthaḥ syāt
buddhyāropitasyaiva viśeṣasya śabdenābhidhānāt
syānmataṃ
yadvinaṣṭaṃ viśeṣyantadviṣayasya śabdasya bhavatu buddhipratibhāsaviṣayatvaṃ
yaḥ punaḥ sannevopādhistadvācinaḥ śabdasya vastuviṣayatvamevāstviti cedāha
buddhipratibhāsetyādi
buddhipratibhāso viṣayo yasyābhidhānasya tattathā
tadbhāvastasmin sati sarvaṃ viśeṣaṇaviṣayābhimatamapyabhidhānantathaiva vikalpabuddhipratibhāsaviṣayamevāstu
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tathā bhinnopādhimato nānāviśeṣaṇavata ekasya grahaṇe buddhāvabhāsanāt
tathā hyupādhimato vinaṣṭasyādhyāhārikā vikalpabuddhiraṅgīkarttavyā
tadā copādhimato'bhāve upādherapyabhāvaḥ pāratantryābhāvāt
bhinnopādhimata ekasyāpratibhāsane kutaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
yadā tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayordvayorapi vikalpabuddhipratibhāsitvamiṣṭantadā kalpita dharmadvayagṛhītaikadharmipratibhāsinyekaiva buddhirjāyata ityaviruddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ
upakāryetyādinā parābhiprāyamāśaṃkate
adoṣo yoyamekasya buddhyādhyāhāra ityādinoktaḥ
upādhimatā samakālasya niṣpannarūpasyopādheḥ pāratantryābhāvādanupādhitvaṃ
prāk pāratantryantadevopādhitvamiti cedāha
netyādi
na hya niṣpannasya śaśaviṣāṇatulyasya pāratantryamupādhitvamvā
sarvathā sato'sataścāsatpāratantryamiti hetoḥ kalpanāropitamupādhīnāmpāratantryaṃ kṛtvā pāratantryavyavahāre
sarvatheti sarveṇa prakāreṇa yathā pāratantryavyavahāre buddhiranuvidhīyate tathā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavyavahāre saivāropikā buddhiḥ kinnānuvidhīyate
tadanuvidhānaṃ hi nyāyyaṃ buddhisandarśitārthapratibhāsamanāśritya vyavaharttumaśakyatvāt
vastuna ekena śabdena pramāṇena ca viṣayīkaraṇe vastubalādvastusvabhāvabhūtāśeṣadharmākṣepāt tadanyasya śabdādervaiyarthyaṃ ca yatprāguktamekasyārthasvabhāvasya pratyakṣasyetyādi
va stu vā di pakṣe tadbuddhipratibhāsānurodhena syāt
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
buddhipratibhāsasya nirvastukatvād vastusāmarthyabhāvināndoṣāṇāmaprasaṅgaḥ
bahuvacanenaitadāha
na kevalaṃ tadanyavaiyarthyadoṣasyāprasaṅgastathā vyatiriktasya sāmānyasyābhāva upādhīnāṃ ca pāratantryāyogāt
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvābhāvaḥ bhinnopādhimata ekasya buddhāvapratibhāsanāt
sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaśca ya uktasteṣāmapyatra sambhavo nāstīti tadevāha
tadabhinnamityādi
tathā hi tadbuddhipratibhāsi rūpamabhinnampratibhāti
tasmāt sāmānyaṃ yathā pratītirna virudhyata iti vacanapariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ
nīlamityukte'nīlavyāvṛttyā nīlatvasyaikasyākārasya viṣayīkaraṇepi vikalpabuddhyā tatraiva nīlākāre saṃśayavyāvṛttirnākārāntare
tatastadbuddhipratibhāsi rūpamaniścitādyākāramanutpalavyāvṛttotpalākārasyāniścayāt
yasminnākāre niścayo notpannastadākārāntarantatra sākāṃkṣayotpalaśabdaprayogād utpannayā buddhyā grāhyaṃ pratibhātīti sambandhaḥ
etena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya nimittamuktaṃ
sāmānādhikaraṇasyāha
bhinnetyādi
bhinnasya śabdārthasya nīlotpalalakṣaṇasyopasaṃhāre pratipādanepi
dharmadvayopagṛhītamabhinnamekadharmitayā buddhipratibhāsarūpaṃ vikalpabuddhau pratibhātīti kṛtvā sāmānyādīni yathāpratīti na virudhyante
tena yaducyate bha ṭṭe na
anyanivṛttimātramapohaṃ gṛhītvā anīlādivyāvṛttāvanutpalādivyāvṛtterabhāvādanutpalādivyāvṛttau cānīlādivyāvṛtterabhāvācca na viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvastayordharmayostadabhāvācca na tadābhidhāyakayoḥ śabdayoḥ śabdayorapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ
nāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ śabdavācyayorbhinnatvāt
nāpi yatrārthe'pohayorbhāvastaddvārakaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamavastutvenāpohasyādheyatvābhāvāt
na ca svalakṣaṇaṃ śabdaviṣayonyaccādhikaraṇaṃ neṣyate
na ca svalakṣaṇepohayorbhāvepi śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamekaviṣayatvasyāpratīterityapāstaṃ
bāhyabhinnasya svākārasya śabdādiviṣayatveneṣṭatvāt tena nīlotpalādiśabdeṣu śabdārthābhidhāyitvamiṣyata eveti sarvaṃ susthaṃ
dharmadharmibhedopyasya buddhipratibhāsasya yathā pratītirna virudhyata iti vacanapariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tamevāneketyādināha
anekasmādarthād buddhipratibhāsasyālīkatvāt
kutonekārthabhedaḥ kevalaṃ puruṣādhyavasāyavaśādevamucyate
tasya buddhipratibhāsasyaikasmādarthād yo bhedastasya vidhipratiṣedhajijñāsāyāṃ
kimanityaḥ śabdo bhavati cākṣuṣo na bhavatīti tadeva buddhipratibhāsabhūtamvastu pradarśyata iti sambandhaḥ
kena prakāreṇetyāha
pratikṣiptetyādi
yadvā dharmadharmibhedopyasya vastuno na virudhyata iti sambandhaḥ
kuta ityāha
anekasmādarthād bāhyasya bhedasambhave sati tasyaikasmād yo bhedastasya vidhipratiṣedhajijñāsāyāṃ kimanityaḥ śabdo bhavati cākṣuṣo na bhavatīti tadeva bāhyamvastu pradarśyata iti sambandhaḥ
kena pradarśyata ityāha
pratikṣiptetyādi
dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmamiva vyavasthāpyeti sambandhaḥ
tathā hyanityatvanna cākṣuṣatvamiti dharmaśabdena codane kṛte vyatirikta ivānityatvādiko dharmo vyavasthāpito bhavati
kiṅkāraṇamityāha
tathā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt

</p></note> śabdena codane vyatiriktasyaiva dharmasya grāhiṇyā buddheḥ pratibhāsanāt
aviśeṣeṇeti sarvabhedāpratikṣepeṇāparamasya bāhyasyāpratikṣiptabhedāntaraṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya śabdena pradarśyate
etaduktambhavati
dharmaśabdena saṃcodya vyatiriktaṃ dharmamiva pradarśya punarddhamiśabdena saṃcodyāparaṃ svabhāvaṃ dharmitayā vyavasthāpya tadeva bāhyaṃ vastu pradarśyate
anityatvaṃ śabdasya na cākṣuṣatvam
anityo na cākṣuṣaḥ śabda iti
bhāvabhāvā'ṅśeneti
bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepeṇa dharmadharmiṇorbhedād bhedavatīva buddhirvikalpikā pratibhāti bhinnākāreva
na tu vastuno bhedaḥ
na vastubhedād bhedavatī buddhiḥ
kutaḥ
yathoktadoṣād anupakāriṇi dharmiṇi dharmāṇāṃ pāratantryāyogāt
tathā sādhyamanityatvaṃ sādhanaṃ kṛtakatvamiti
sādhyasādhanabhedaścetyata āha
tathābhūtetyādi
tathābhūtānāmpratikṣiptabhedāntarāṇāṃ dharmabhedānāmbāhulyacodanayā vacanabhedaḥ sādhyasādhanabhedaśca kriyata iti sambandhaḥ
tasya tatastato vyāvṛttasya vastunaḥ svabhāvaḥ samāśrayo yeṣāntairddharmapratibhāsabhedairvikalpabuddhiprativimbairddharmātmakaiḥ pratibhāsabhedairityarthaḥ
kimarthaṃ kriyata ityāha
tatsvabhāvetyādi
tasyaiva vyāvṛttasya vastusvabhāvasya pratipattaye prāptaye vā
praṇālikayā teṣāmvastupratibandhāt prakṛtasyaivārthasya sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ saṃgrahaślokamāha
tatsvabhāvetyādi
tasya vastusvabhāvasyānubhavādūrddhvaṃ yā dhīḥ prajñāyate vikalpikā
apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ
anarthikāpi tadartheva
vastuviṣayeva
adhyavasāyavaśādatatkāryebhyo yo bhedastanniṣṭhā
tadanubhavabalotpattervyāvṛttasya ca vastunaḥ samvādāttanniṣṭhetyucyate
tasyāmitthaṃ bhūtāyāmbuddhau yorthākāraḥ dṛśyavikalpayorekīkaraṇād bāhyamiva
sajātīyāsu vyaktiṣu samampratibhāsamānamekamivānyato vijātīyād vyāvṛttamivābhāti
tattu vyāvṛttameva buddhirūpasyālīkatvāt
tadbuddhirūpaṃ nistattvaṃ niḥsvabhāvaṃ
kiṅkāraṇaṃ
parīkṣānaṅgabhāvataḥ
arthakriyāsamarthameva parīkṣāṅgamataḥ parīkṣānaṅgabhāvenārthakriyāṃ pratyasamarthatvādityuktambhavati
yataśca buddhipratibhāsi rūpannistattvamatastadviṣayo vyavahāro mithyārtha eva pravarttate ityāha
arthā ityādi
jñānaviśiṣṭā iti vikalpabuddhyārūḍhāste jñānaviśiṣṭāssantaḥ yato vijātīyād vyāvṛttirūpiṇo vyāvṛttirūpavantaḥ
yathānutpalād vyāvṛttirūpiṇa utpalārthāḥ
tenetyantato vyāvṛttirūpeṇotpalatvenābhinnā ivābhānti na paramārthato buddhirūpasyālīkatvāt
etena sāmānyavyavahārasya nimittamuktaṃ
vyāvṛttāḥ punaranyatasta eveti
ta eva jñānaviśiṣṭā arthā anyato vyāvṛttirūpiṇaḥ santaḥ punaranyataḥ sajātīyādapi vyāvṛttā bhānti
yathā ta eva nīlabhedā anīlāt
ataśca vyāvṛttidvayopagṛhītasyaikasyārthasya bhāsanāt
sāmānādhikaraṇyabījamuktaṃ
tadevāha
teṣāmityādi
teṣāmiti buddhipratibhāsināmarthānāṃ vyavahāraḥ pratanyata iti sambandhaḥ
teṣāmiti vyavahārāpekṣā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī
kiṃviśiṣṭo mithyārthaḥ
kaiḥ karaṇabhūtairityāha
sāmānyetyādi
samānādhāratvaṃ samānādhāraḥ
bhāvapradhānatvānnirdeśasya
sāmānyaviṣayaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaviṣayaiśca jñānābhidhānaiḥ sāmānyagocaraiḥ sāmānyavyavahāraḥ pratanyate
itaraiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavyavahāraḥ
yadyapi śabdajñānātmaka eveha vyavahārastathāpi savyāpāratāmupādāya jñānaśabdayoḥ karaṇarūpatā
tayorevārthaprakāśalakṣaṇā kriyā vyavahāratvena vivakṣitetyadoṣaḥ
yathā jñānasya pramāṇatvaṃ phalatvaṃ veti
sa ca sarvaḥ jñānābhidhānalakṣaṇo vyavahāraḥ padārthānāṃ svalakṣaṇānāṃ yonyonyābhāvaḥ parasparavyacchedastatsaṃśrayaḥ
vyāvṛttapadārthānubhavadvāreṇotpatteḥ
tenetyanyonyābhāvasaṃśrayatvena sa vyavahāronyāpohaviṣaya ucyate na tvanyavyāvṛttiviṣayatvāt
vidhiviṣayatvādasya vyavahārasya
vastulābhasya ca vastuprāpteścāśrayo na bhavati vyavahāraḥ
na ca sarvaḥ kintu yatra vyavahāre'sti pāramparyeṇa tathābhūtavastusambandhaḥ
udāharaṇamāha
yathoktānumitau yatheti
yathoktānumitiḥ pūrvoktānumānavikalpaḥ
nānyatra sthirādivikalpe tatra pāramparyeṇāpi vastusambandhābhāvāt
vastuno'sthirādirūpatvāt
anumānavikalpasyetarasya ca svapratibhāsenarthe'rthādhyavasāyad bhrāntisāmyepi
dīpatejo maṇau yatheti
yathā maṇitejasi maṇibuddhirbhrāntā
tathā dīpatejasyapitulyepi bhrāntatve maṇiprabhā maṇitvena gṛhītā maṇāvadhigantavye samvādikā
na tu dīpatejaḥ
tadvat sthirādivikalpo samvādaka ityarthaḥ
yadi jñānaniviṣṭānāmevārthānāṃ sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ bāhyeṣvartheṣu tarhi sāmānyādivyavahārābhāvāt pravṛttirna syādityata āha
tatretyādi
tatra śabdo vākyopanyāse
nirddhāraṇe vā
tatra vyaktiṣvekakāryā vyaktayo nirddhāryante
anekopyekakāryo yathā ghaṭabhedā evodakāharaṇādikāryāstadakāryāya tathābhūtakāryanukurvate
tebhyonyatāvyāvṛttiḥ sā āśrayo yeṣāṃ jñānābhidhānāttairanekopi padārtha ekatvena vyavahārampratāryate
sāmānyavyavahāraṃ prāpyata iti yāvat
tathetyanantarasāmānyavyapekṣayā
ekopyanekakāryakṛt
yathā ghaṭaśca cakṣurvijñānodakāharaṇādikāryakṛt
tadbhāvadīpane
anekakāryakarttṛtvaprakāśane
atatkāryebhyo bhedena hetunā
nānādharmā ghaṭaścākṣuṣaḥ pārthiva ityādi
tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvavyavahāraśca bāhyeṣveva darśitaḥ
yadi bāhyeṣu sāmānyādivyavahāraḥ pāramārthikastarhi prāpta ityāha
yathāpratītikathitaḥ iti
vikalpabuddhyanurodhena śabdārthaḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇaḥ paramārthatosāvasannapi yathāpratītikathitaḥ
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca yathāpratītikathitaṃ
yasmād vastunyasya śabdārthasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasya ca na sambhavaḥ
dharmadharmivyavahāraśca jñānapratibhāsinyartha iti yat prakṛtantatsaṃgrahārthamāha
dharmetyādi
ayaṃ dharmo'yaṃ dharmīti vyavasthānantayośca bhedo'syāyaṃ dharmaḥ kṛtakatvādilakṣaṇaḥ
abhedaḥ kṛtakoyamiti yādṛśaḥ
ayaṃ ca vikalpāropitatvāt
asamīkṣitatattvārthaḥ
anapekṣitastattvārtho vastvartho yeneti vigrahaḥ
yathā loke buddhyārūḍhopyadhyavasitatadbhāvatayā pratīyate
taṃ dharmādivibhāgantathaiveti yathālokapratītiḥ sādhyasādhanasaṃsthitirvidvadbhiravakalpyata iti sambandhaḥ
kimarthaṃ
paramārthāvatārāya
anityādivastusvabhāvasyāvagāhanāya
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamekatvādivyavahārasya vastunyasambhava ityāha
saṃsṛjyanta ityādi
pāramārthikā arthāḥ svato na saṃsṛjyante
tato na sāmānyavyavahāro vastuni
na bhidyante kṛtakatvādidharmaiḥ pratyekaṃ tasya vastunonekatvāyogāt
ataśca teṣvartheṣu bahuṣu rūpamekamekaṃsminnarthe'nekaṃ rūpaṃ yadadhyavasīyate tadbuddhervikalpikāyā upaplavo bhrāntiḥ
yataśca na saṃsṛjyante na bhidyante pāramārthikā arthāḥ
tataḥ kāraṇāt sāmānyamidaṃ bahūnāṃ
tathā dharmāṇāṃ dharmiṇāṃ ca bheda ityapi yoyambhedo nānātvavyavahāraḥ sa bauddherthe
na bāhye svalakṣaṇe
buddhipratibhāsasyālīkatvāt
kathantarhi tatra svalakṣaṇe kṛtakatvādidharmabheda iti cedāha
tasyaiva cetyādi
tasyaiva svalakṣaṇasyānyavyāvṛttyā dharmabhedaḥ prakalpyate
kasmāt kalpitadharmabhedadvāreṇa gamyagamakabhāvo na vastudarśanamātreṇetyata āha
sādhyetyādi
idaṃ sādhyamidaṃ sādhanamityasmin saṃkalpe vastudarśanahānitaḥ
yadvā pratyakṣavadanumānena sāmānyaviśiṣṭaṃ svalakṣaṇameva kasmānna gṛhyata ityata āha
sādhyetyādi
sādhyasādhanasaṃkalpe vastudarśanahānitaḥ
kutaḥ svalakṣaṇasya sāmānyaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇaṃ
bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya ityācārya di gnā ga prabhṛtibhiḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭasya svalakṣaṇasya grahaṇaṃ pratijñātamityāśaṅkāmapanayannāha
bheda ityādi
bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭaḥ pratīyata ityatrāpi vacane grāhyaṃ na svalakṣaṇameva nirdiṣṭamiti naivamboddhavyamityarthaḥ
kintu bāhyā eva bhedāstenānyāpohalakṣaṇena sāmānyena saṃsṛṣṭā adhyavasīyante na tu gṛhyanta iti tatrāpi boddhavyaṃ
anye tu bhedaḥ sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya iti pulliṅgena paṭhanti
tatrāyamartho bhedaḥ
sāmānyasaṃsṛṣṭo grāhya ityatrāpi vacane
na svalakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ
kimpunaḥ kāraṇantatraiva boddhavyamiti cedāha
samānetyādi
anekasminnekākāraḥ samānākāraḥ
ekasminnanekadharmatvambhinnākāraḥ
ādiśabdād dharmadharmyākāraparigrahaḥ
na tat svalakṣaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ kathaṃcana
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tatraikasmin svalakṣaṇe kṛtakatvānityatvādirūpeṇa bahubhedānāndharmāṇāṃ kimviśiṣṭānāmbhedānāmvasturūpāṇāntatraikasmin svalakṣaṇe'yogāt
na hyekasya vasturūpāṇi bahūni yujyante niraṅśatvāt svalakṣaṇasya
upasaṃharannāha
tadrūpamityādi
tattasmād rūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ sarvato bhinnamasādhāraṇantathā tenāsādhāraṇena rūpeṇa tasya svalakṣaṇasya na pratipādikā śrutiḥ śabdo nāsti
kalpanā vāsti
neti prakṛtaṃ
asādhāraṇena svarūpeṇa svalakṣaṇasya grāhako nāstītyarthaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
sāmānyenaiva śabdasya kalpanāyāśca vṛttitaḥ
tatpratipādikā na śrutirastīti bruvatā svalakṣaṇe śabdā na niyujyanta ityuktamataścodayati
kimpunarityādi
saṃketena viṣayīkṛtāḥ saṃketinaḥ
tamāhuḥ śabdāḥ
vyavahārāya saṃketaḥ smṛtaḥ
tadā vyavahārakāle tatsvalakṣaṇannāsti yatra saṃketaḥ kṛtaḥ

tatasteṣvasau tadbhedo vikalpabuddhyā sarveṣvekatvenāropyata iti samānākārabhāsī bhavati

pradīpakṛtena ca vijñānajananasamarthasvarūpotpādena ghaṭapradīpādīnāṃ vyaṅgyavyañjakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandha ityevamanyasminnapi sambandhe yathāyogaṃ vācyaṃ
nanu sarva eva vastusambandhā ityādinā na saṃyogalakṣaṇasya sambandhasya kāryakāraṇabhāventarbhāvaḥ samānakālabhāvinorevāsya sattvāt
athākṣaṇikapakṣe saṃyogotpattirna yujyate
kṣaṇike tarhi bhaviṣyati saṃyuktāsaṃyuktāvasthayośca kuṇḍabadarayorna svarūpabhedaḥ pratīyate
tenākṣaṇikepi saṃyogostyeva pratīteḥ
yadāho dyo ta ka raḥ
yadi saṃyogo na nārthāntarambhavettadā kṣetrabījodakādayo nirviśiṣṭatvāt sarvadaivāṃkurādikāryaṃ kuryu rnacaivaṃ
tasmāt sarvadā kāryānārambhāt kṣetrādīnyaṅkurotpattau kāraṇāntarasāpekṣāṇi
yathā mṛtpiṇḍādisāmagrī ghaṭādikaraṇe kulālādisāpekṣā
yo sau kṣetrādinirapekṣaḥ sa saṃyoga iti siddhaṃ
kiṃ cāsau saṃyogo dravyayorviśeṣaṇabhāvena pratīyamānatvāttatorthāntaratvena pratyakṣasiddha eva
tathā hi kaścit kenacit saṃyukte dravye āharetyukto yayoreva dravyayoḥ saṃyogamupalabhate te evāharati
na dravyamātraṃ
kiṃ ca dūrataravarttinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntarepi vane nirantararūpāvasāyinī seyaṃ buddhirudayamāsādayati mithyābuddhirmukhyapadārthānubhavamantareṇa na kvacidupajāyate
na hyananubhūtagodarśanasya gavaye gauriti vibhramo bhavati tasmādavaśyaṃ saṃyogo mukhyobhyupagantavyaḥ
tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyanena pratiṣedhavākyena na kuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate tasyānyatra deśādau sattvāt
tasmāccaitrasya kuṇḍalasaṃyogaḥ pratiṣidhyate
tathā caitraḥ kuṇḍalītyanenāpi vidhivākyena na caitrakuṇḍalayoranyataravidhānantayoḥ siddhatvāt
pāriśeṣyāt saṃyogavidhānaṃ
tasmādastyeva saṃyoga iti
Nyāyavārtika.

tannimittopyasadvyavahāraḥ siddha eveti kintenāsadvyavahāreṇa
adṛśyānupalabdhāvapi sadvyavahāranimittasyābhāvād vyavahārāpravṛttiḥ siddhaiveti sadvyavahāraniṣedhenāpi sādhitena kiṃ
tathā pūrvaprasiddhaviṣayopadarśanalakṣaṇena dṛṣṭāntenāpyanupalabdhau na kiṃcit prayojanamityata āha
soyamityādi
mūḍhaṃ pratyetat sādhyata iti yāvat
kvacidapyasadvyavahāranimittaṃ dṛśyānupalambhamabhyupagamyāsadvyavahārapravṛttimvilomayannakurvan
adṛśyānupalabdhau tadabhāvaṃ ca sadvyavahāranimittasya pramāṇasyābhāvaṃ cābhyupagamya sadvyavahāranivṛttiṃ ca vilomayannakurvan
yathābhyupagamaṃ pratipādyata iti dṛśyānupalambhena nimittena tvayā'sadvyavahāronyatra kṛtastadihāpyasti
tasmādasadvyavahāraṅ kurviti pratipādyate
tathā pramāṇena nimittena tvayā kvacit sadvyavahāraḥ kṛtastadihāpyanirupākhye nāsti
tasmād sadvyavāhārammā kurviti pratipādyate
kimiva nirupākhyavat
yathā śaśaviṣāṇādāvasadvyavahāranimittasya dṛśyānupalambhasya bhāvādasadvyavahārastathehāpīti
anyadveti
yathā sannihitanimittasyā'ṅkurādeḥ pratipattireva sadvyavahārasyāpīti
yathā ca nirupākhye pramāṇābhāvāt sadvyavahārasya nivṛttiḥ
anyasmin vā kāraṇavikale kārye nivṛttistadvad viprakṛṣṭeṣu sadvyavahārasya nivṛttiriti pratipādyate
sa eva tāvadupalabdhyabhāvonupalabdhyākhyaḥ kathaṃ kena pramāṇena siddhaḥ
na pratyakṣeṇābhāvaviṣayatvavirodhāt
nāpyanumānena pratyakṣapūrvakatvādasya
nāpi pradeśasambandhyanupalambho'bhāvasya nīrūpatvena sambandhitvāyogāt
pradeśasyānupalambhe ca dharmmasiddherāśrayāsiddho heturityanupalabdherna pakṣadharmatvamityudyo ta ka ra prabhṛtayaḥ
atrāha
etaduttaratra vakṣyāmastadviśiṣṭopalambho'tastasyāpyanupalambhananta smādanupalambhoyaṃ pratyakṣeṇaiva siṃdhyatīti
yatpunaruktamanupalabdhau kindṛṣṭāntopadarśanenetyāha
anyatrāpītyādi
vidhisādhanepyanumāne sādhyadharmeṇa vyāpakena vyāpyadharmaṃ kṛtakatvādikaṃ sādhanamicchan pratipādyaḥ kimiti dṛṣṭāntena pratyāyyaḥ
kiṅkāraṇaṃ

niścitārthassambandhalakṣaṇo yena tasya vyāmūḍhamprati smṛtyarthaḥ
tadetad dṛṣṭāntena mūḍhaṃ prati smṛtijananamatrānupalabdhau

etadeva kutaḥ

itaśca nākramasya vākyasya pratibhāsaḥ

tadā tairvarṇṇairyathākathaṃcit tatkramairanyakramairapi prayuktairyatkiñcid vākyaṃ pratīyeta
sarostīti prayukte rasostīti pratīyeta
varṇṇopakārānapekṣatvād vināpi vā varṇṇairvākyaṃ pratīyeta
na ca varṇṇopakārāpekṣayā vākyapratītiḥ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tairvarṇṇairanukramavadbhirasya vākyasyopakārāyogāt

na caivamiṣyate

naiva vākye varṇṇāḥ santi

tadvyakteḥ

tāmeva darśayannāha
netyādi
sā vyaktiryathā svavarṇṇābhivyaktipratyayānāṃ

ityapi mithyā
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tasyā vyakternityeṣu prāgeva sā mā nya vya kti ci ntāsthāne niṣiddhatvāt
tadeva smārayannāha
kāryatetyādi

yasmāt
yat khalu rūpaṃ yata evopalabhyate tasya rūpasya lokaḥ kāryatāṃ prajñāpayatīti samba ndhaḥ
yata evopalabhyata iti yacchabdena yo nirdiṣṭastasyopalabdhistadupalabdhistannāntarīyikāmevopalabdhimāśrityeti bhinnakrama evakāraḥ
sā yathoktopalabdhirvarṇṇeṣvapyasti

sā copalabdhiranyatrāpi kāryatvena prasiddhe vastuni
tadāśrayaḥ kāryatāprajñapterāśrayaḥ
nātodhiko viśeṣaḥ

netyādi paraḥ
na caitadupalabdhyāśrayā

yatsatyeva bhavati

iti evaṃ sattāśrayā kāryatāsthitiḥ

sā sattetyācā ryaḥ

na hyasiddhāyāmasyāṃ sattāyāmevambhavati
satyevāsminnidaṃ bhavatītyevambhavati
tasmāt sattāsiddhistatsādhanī
tasyāḥ kāryatāyāḥ sādhanī
sā siddhirupalabdhireva siddherjñānasvabhāvatvāt
tataśca yannāntarīyikaiva yatsattopalabdhistattasya kāryamityetāvat sthitaṃ
tacca varṇṇeṣvapi tulyamiti kathaṃ na varṇṇāḥ kāryāḥ
sattyamityādi paraḥ
sattyamevaṃ karaṇavyāpārādeva śabdopalabdhau tatkāryatā syāt
yadi tasya śabdasya tālvādivyāpārāt sattā na siddhā syāt
kintu siddhaiva pramāṇena
tathā hi pūrvaṃ gośabdaṃ śrutavataḥ puṃsonyadā gośabdaśravaṇe sa evāyaṃ gośabda iti tattvagrāhiṇī pratyabhijñotpadyate
tattvagrahaṇamevānyathā na syāt
yadi pūrvottaraśravaṇakālayorantarāle śabdo na syādityarthāpattyā prākchabdasya sattā siddhaiva
na ca siddhipūrvikā siddhiḥ kāryatāsādhanī
kintu sā hi sattāsiddhiḥ kāryatvaprajñapternimittaṃ yā siddhipūrvikā
yathā ghaṭasya prāgasataḥ kulālādivyāpārādeva paścāt siddhiḥ
nanvityādi si ddhā nta vā dī
etat kathayati

katarat tad rūpamityāha

nīrūpatve tu vināśasya syād bhāvena sahāyaṃ virodhaḥ
kintu tadāpyarthāntaratvaṃ hetujanyatvaṃ cāsya na syānnīrūpatvādeva
tasmādagninārthāntarasya karaṇe kāṣṭhantadavasthaṃ dṛśyeta
tenāgnikṛtenārthāntareṇa parigrahataḥ svīkārāt kāṣṭhaṃ na dṛśyata iti cet
eva sati tadarthāntaraṃ kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇamiti prāptaṃ
tacca na yuktaṃ
yato na tenārthāntareṇa kāṣṭhasyāvaraṇaṃ sambhavati
yadītyādinā vyācaṣṭe
tenārthāntareṇāgninā kṛtena
tadityagnikṛtamarthāntaraṃ
na caitadāvaraṇakalpitaṃ yuktaṃ
yasmādāvaraṇaṃ hi
āvriyamāṇerthadarśanamvibadhnīyāt
nābhighātāvīni dravyasāmarthyāni vibadhnīyāt
andhakārā vṛtānāṃ ghaṭādīnāmabhidhātādidarśanāt
tatra svadeśe parasyotpattivibandhobhighātaḥ
ādiśabdād gandharasādiparigrahaḥ
athāvaraṇaṃ sarvasāmarthyaṃ kāṣṭhasya nibadhnīyāt
tadā sarvapratibandhe cābhyupagamyamāne
na-tvanenaivāvaraṇena kāṣṭhannāśitaṃ syānna vahninā
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tenaivāsya kāṣṭhasya sarvaśaktipracyāvanāt
tathā ca sati punastatrāpyagnikṛterthāntare nāśahetāvagnāviva prasaṃgāt
kāṣṭhavināśaṃ prati yognau doṣo vistareṇoktaḥ sorthāntareṇāpyagnikṛtena kāṣṭhanāśe kriyamāṇe syāt
tathā cānavasthā
tenāpyarthāntareṇāgnikṛtena nāśenāparamarthāntarannāśākhyaṃ karttavyantenāpyaparamityanavasthā syād
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityapracyutā eva kāṣṭhasyābhidhātādisāmarthyādayaḥ
tadāpyapracyuteṣu vāsya kāṣṭhasyābhighātasāmarthyādiṣu
satā vā tenānyenāgni janitena kāṣṭhasya kiṃ vināśitaṃ yena tadāvaraṇantathā ca kāṣṭhaṃ dṛśyeta
yadi cetyādi
agneḥ samudbhavo yasyeti vigrahaḥ
agnisamudbhūtena vināśākhyenārthena parigrahādityarthaḥ
tadā vināśasya vināśitvaṃ syāt
kiṃ kāraṇam
utpatteḥ
utpattimatvād vināśopi kāṣṭhavad vināśī syāditi yāvat
tato vināśavināśāt punaḥ kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ syāt
avaśyamityādinā vyācaṣṭe
utpattimatā satā kāṣṭhavināśenāvaśyaṃ vinaṣṭavyaṃ
tasmin kāṣṭhanāśe vinaṣṭe sati punaḥ kāṣṭhādīnāmunmajjanaṃ syāt
prādurbhāvo bhavet
hantughātetyādinā paramāśaṃkate
caitrasya yo hantā tasya hanturghāte sati yathā
hatasya caitrasyāpunarbhāvaḥna punaranutpattiḥ
atrāpi kāṣṭhanāśe vinaṣṭepyevaṃ kāṣṭhasyāpunarbhāva iti cet
hanturityādinā pratividhatte
nedaṃ samādhānaṃ yuktaṃ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
hanturamaraṇatvataḥ
na hi hantā caitrasya maraṇasvabhāvaḥ
kintarhi
mārayitā
tato yuktaṃ yat tannāśe caitrasyāpunarbhavanaṃ
maraṇe tvanivṛtte'vaśyaṃ punarbhavanaṃ syāt
vināśetyādinā vyācaṣṭe
vināśasya vināśepi na vastunaḥ pratyāpattirna pūrvarūpagamanaṃ
yasmānna hi hantari hatepi tadvatastena hantrā puruṣeṇa hataḥ pratyujjīvati
nāyamparihāro yuktaḥ
kasmād
hantuḥ puruṣasya tadghātahetutvāt

na tvasau hantā maraṇasvabhāvaḥ
etadeva spaṣṭayannāha
netyādi
nāśahetoragnidaṇḍādernivṛttau satyāmvinaṣṭena bhāvena punarbhavativyamiti na brūmaḥ
evamabhidhāne bhavedeṣa parihāraḥ

vah nyādinā kāṣṭhāderbhāvasyābhāvo yaḥ kriyate tasya
kimbhūtasya
atyantānupalabdhilakṣaṇasya

tatpratiṣedhenātyantānupalabdhiḥ sarvasāmarthyaviraha ucyate

svabhāvasthitireva gatiriti yāvat
hantari tu vinaṣṭe nayuktaṃ punarbhavanaṃ
yasmāddhantā hi caitrasya na nāśakalpaḥ
kintarhi
daṇḍādikalpaḥ daṇḍāditulyaḥ nāśahetutvāt
nāśakalpaṃ hyasya caitrasya maraṇaṃ
tannivṛttau tasya nāśakalpasya maraṇasya nivṛttau syādevāsya caitrasya punarbhāvaḥ
evantāvat nāśasyārthāntaratve doṣa uktaḥ
anarthāntaratvamadhikṛtyāha
ananyatvepītyādi
vastuno nāśasyānanyatvepi syānnāśaḥ kāṣṭhameva tu
tasya ca kāṣṭhasya svahetorutpannasya satvāt
na vahnyādibhiḥ kiñcit karttavyamiti tatsvabhāvasya nāśasyāhetutvaṃ
nātastattvānyatvavikalpānnāśasya vastudharmasya vidyatenyā gatiḥ
anarthāntara ityādinā vyācaṣṭe
kāṣṭhādanarthāntarabhūto yadā vināśastadā tadeva kāṣṭhameva tadvināśākhyamvastu bhavati
tacca kāṣṭhādi
vahnyādisannidhānāt prāgevāstīti
kimatra kāṣṭhādau vināśye sāmarthyamvahnyādīnāmiti draṣṭavyaṃ
kvacid daṇḍādīnāmiti pāṭhaḥ sa tu ghaṭādīn purodhāya vyākhyeyaḥ
tasmāt tadanukārāt
tatra kāṣṭhādau vināśahetūnāmanupakārāt tena kāṣṭhādinā vināśahetavo nāpekṣyante kathaṃcit kenāpi rūpeṇa
nāpyasya kāṣṭāderidamvahnyādikaṃ vināśaheturiti sambandhamarhati
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ
tasyopakāranibandhanatvāt
anyathopakāramantareṇa sambandhakalpanāyāmatiprasaṃgāt
sarvaḥ sarvasya sambandhī syāt
syādetat
na sākṣād vanhyādiḥ kāṣṭhāderupakārakaḥ kintu tatsambandhibhūtopakārakaraṇāditi
ata āha
pāramparyeṇetyādi
vahnyādinā kāṣṭhādeḥ sambandhibhūta upakāraḥ kriyate na sākṣāditi
evaṃ pāramparyeṇopakārepi kalpyamāne'vaśyamayamvikalponvetyanugacchati
sa kimpāramparyeṇāpyupakārorthāntaramāhosvit tadeva kāṣṭhādikamiti
tatra tasmāt kāṣṭhāderarthāntaratvepyupakārasya
tasya kāṣṭhāderayamupakāra iti kassambandha iti
tatra kāṣṭhādau tasyāgnikṛtasyopakārasyopakārakatvaṃ paryanuyojyaṃ
tadantareṇa sambandhābhāvāt
ādiśabdāt tatrāpyaparopakārakalpanetyanavasthādoṣādiparigrahaḥ
tathānanyatvepyupakārasya tadavasthaḥ paryanuyogaḥ syānnāśaḥ kāṣṭhamevetyādinā ya uktaḥ tasmāt sato vidyamānasya rūpasya tattvānyattvāvyatikramāt kāraṇāt
syādetat
sato rūpasya tattvānyattvāvyatikramād vināśahetukṛtaṃ tūpakārotpādanamasadeveti

upakāretyādi

ubhayathā cokto doṣa iti

kathamityādinā vyācaṣṭe

ataḥ kāraṇādavināśī bhāvaḥ syādityaprasaṃga eva
kiṃ kāraṇam

necchet
kathamityādi paraḥ
asatyavidyamāne vināśe kathambhāvo naṣṭo nāma
naiva vinaṣṭaḥ syāt
tathā hi pratyutpannāvasthāyāmasadvināśāḥ
asadvināśo yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ
te na hi naṣṭā gaṇyante

tamasyetyādi

tadetad yathoktena prakāreṇābhāvādavyatirikta nnāśitvantatvato vyavasthāpitamapi mandamatayo nāśaṃ guṇaṃ dharmaṃ samāropyātmānamākulayantītyanena sambandhaḥ

kiṃ kāraṇam

ayamityādinā vyācaṣṭe

na caivaṃ pratipadyate
tasmādayaṃ mantrākhyo varṇṇānukramaḥ svabhāvato yadi nāma kāryakṛdabhyupagato mī māṃ sa kai stathāpi kaścideva puruṣairatīndriyaśaktibhedayukto vijñāta iti kṛtvāsti parokṣārthadarśī puruṣo yo mantrantatsāmarthyantadanuṣṭhānañca vetti

svato hi phaladāne'yaṃ kālabhedo na yujyate mantrasya kenacidutkarṣānutkarṣākaraṇāt

vrataṃ mantrakalpavihito niyamastasya caraṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ
apiśabdāddhomādiparigrahaḥ
svabhāvato hi phaladāne
kiṃ vratacaryādyanuṣṭhānenāpekṣitena
tatotiśayānutpatteḥ

vahatāmapīti

na hyayaṃ prakāro vastusvabhāve yuktaḥ

netyādinā pratiṣedhati

nidarśanaṃ cāha
yo madīyaṃ kāvyādyevaṃ paṭhiṣyati tasya mayāyamarthaḥ sampādanīya ityevaṃkṛtaḥ samayo yasmin kāvyādau ādiśabdācchilpasthānādau
sa kṛtasamayaḥ kāvyādiḥ tasminniva tadvat
yathā tatra kāvyādipāṭhakānāṃ puruṣādhiṣṭhānāt phalantadvanmantreṣvapītyarthaḥ
puṃsāmatīndriyārthadarśanaṃ prati śaktirnāstītyevamaśaktisādhanamasāmarthyasya sādhanaṃ yannāma kiñcit mī māṃ sa kai rucyate tatsarvamanenaiva mantrakāriṇāṃ jñānaprabhāvātiśayasādhanena nirākṛtaṃ
pratipāditā hītyādinā vyācaṣṭe
